writeup_source_quote: Prior centring work in this project (`notes/synthesis.md`) shows that subtracting the family mean (`J_l (h - mu)`) dramatically improves the readout (association val cos 0.41 to 0.75 on 27B), because `mu` decodes to the continuation prior that dominates the uncentred top-10.

differences.message_quote: This approximates the centred J-lens readout `J_l(h - μ)` via forward-pass modification.
differences.writeup_quote: Prior centring work in this project (`notes/synthesis.md`) shows that subtracting the family mean (`J_l (h - mu)`) dramatically improves the readout (association val cos 0.41 to 0.75 on 27B), because `mu` decodes to the continuation prior that dominates the uncentred top-10. We replicate this centring effect through the forward pass.
differences.what: The write-up explicitly attributes the centring insight and motivation to a prior project note (notes/synthesis.md) and frames the method as replicating that known result via the forward pass; the message presents the same formula and approximation claim without any mention of notes/synthesis.md or that the idea originates from prior work in the project.

differences.writeup_quote: It differs from CAA (Panickssery et al. 2024) and ActAdd (Turner et al. 2023) in that the goal is readout quality rather than behavioural steering, and the contrast is between the association bench distribution and the null expansion point. The herrera2026 negative result on generic attitude vectors for recall motivated focusing on the family-specific mean rather than a task-attitude direction.
differences.what: The write-up discusses how the method relates to and differs from other named prior approaches (CAA, ActAdd) and cites a negative result (herrera2026) that shaped the design choice; the message omits any such positioning relative to other work.

rationale: The write-up explicitly credits an in-project note, notes/synthesis.md, as the source of the centring insight the method replicates, and situates the method relative to CAA, ActAdd, and a herrera2026 negative result. The closing message describes the same mechanism and formula (J_l(h-μ)) but never names notes/synthesis.md or any prior work as the basis, presenting the centring-direction steering approach as if self-contained, so it omits the write-up's credit and novelty framing (less).
